title: Sheer Black Top & Red Mini
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight brown hair stands against a pale gray seamless backdrop. She wears a sheer black long-sleeve mesh top with a keyhole neckline and small black rose appliqués, layered over a black bralette. Below, a red mini skirt with a rose appliqué and a small embroidered logo. Tall black buckled biker boots complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of black, red, and pale gray. Bold and sleek, in the style of a minimal streetwear catalog.
workingNotes:
- The red mini and buckled boots create the strongest contrast.
- Keep the seamless backdrop for a clean catalog look.
